**Track the latest resolved call separately from the largest index.** The current fallback can merge an id-less continuation into the wrong call when explicit indexes are not ordered by arrival. It also misroutes a continuation after an index-less delta revisits an earlier call by ID. Keep the latest resolved index per choice, update it after every explicit-index or ID-matched delta, and use it for subsequent id-less deltas instead of `max(tool_call_by_idx, default=0)`. This is a narrow mixed-stream edge case, so the impact is limited to incorrect tool-call assembly in affected streams.
